messages:
jen: getting reports that video is back but audio is ~1.5s ahead of video (weird lip-sync) for some viewers, captions also out of sync. hosting in EU/NA looks fine but APAC watchers hit the issue. @video-team? :headphones:
mark: checking edge transcoder metrics. I see mismatched segment durations hitting our CDN edge in APAC; looks like a profile mismatch in the upstream packager. grabbing logs now.
mark: ```packager-apac WARN segment_duration_mismatch expected=2000ms got=1800ms
packager-apac ERROR transmux-pts-offset=1500us```
priya: that would explain 1.5s. can we force a transmux with corrected timestamps or repackage on the fly? Gabe, can you push a temp rule at the edge to normalize segment durations?
gabe: pushing edge rule to adjust segment timestamps for APAC. rolling in 30s. also enabling higher-fidelity keyframe passthrough to avoid re-encoding jitter.
ops-bot: Incident created IN-2026-999: all-hands lip-sync in APAC -> paging video-team.
emma: starting a local OBS full-capture just in case: profile allhands_lipfix -> /tmp/allhands_lipfix.mp4. cmd: `obs-cli --startrecording`
zach: captions pipeline shows stable timestamps upstream; mismatch seems introduced during packaging for HLS variants. adding a debug flag to captions worker to emit per-segment pts.
leo: leadership wants to continue Q&A audio-first and annotate the meeting notes with the timestamp. I'll put slide: "Minor lip-sync in APAC viewers, proceeding audio-first" and notify attendees.
marta: product team asked if we can timestamp the transcript with a fixed offset for APAC VOD to make clips shareable; is that possible?
mark: once packager rule lands we should see frames re-align. doing DNS/waf push in 10...9...8... rule applied. monitoring packager logs.
mark: packager reports normalized segment durations and pts offsets fixed. can APAC folks confirm if lip-sync is improving? :eyes:
gabe: APAC CDN logs show decreased retransmits and alignment improved. pushing a followup job to repackage the last 90s segment for VOD stitching.
emma: local file confirmed writing and contains the missing 90s with proper sync. starting checksum and will upload on completion.
priya: action item: add a preflight check for packager variant mismatches in the all-hands runbook. this would have caught the profile drift.
ops-bot: Action logged: TICKET-ALLHANDS-205 "Preflight packager-variant check for all-hands" assigned to infra.
zach: note for UI: add a tiny overlay text that shows package variant and last-segment-duration so we spot this quickly. filing as video-team task.
leo: i'll coordinate with product on the APAC transcript offset approach. short-term we can publish VOD with corrected timestamps using emma's local + repackaged segment.
jen: thanks all. please prioritize the runbook item and the overlay. also mark: can you schedule a quick postmortem with logs and the packager diff?
mark: creating a short postmortem doc and uploading encoder/packager logs to s3://infra-logs/allhands/1915000000/packager.log (video-team perms).
gabe: uploaded the repackaged APAC segment to s3://allhands-raw/1915000000/repackage/ and started an async stitch job for the VOD.
emma: uploaded local capture to https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1915000000/allhands_local.mp4 (checksum OK).
leo: stitched VOD with corrected APAC segment and transcript offsets. link: https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1915000000/vod-corrected.mp4. short notes attached in the post.
jen: confirming receipt and adding follow-ups: - runbook preflight check - UI variant overlay - automated local-capture default - schedule postmortem. closing thread once docs live. :white_check_mark:
